answer.reason: The limiter reports an unblocked key as a wait of 0.0. With `< 0.0` the "available" set comes out empty, so the code falls through to the fallback branch. That branch takes the keys with the smallest wait, which is 0.0, so it picks exactly the same unblocked keys. When every key is blocked, both versions also pick the same shortest-wait keys, so the chosen credential and the wait are identical, provided wait_seconds is never negative.
